authorization: Continuation requested by the user for the first aircraft-facade contact sequence. This iteration changes only one skin-stringer attachment zone in a small I02A-like wing bay.

speed.source: Cached I02A value from NIST NCSTAR 1-2B Table 7-3; not inferred from a video

facade_column.classification: One 508 mm long closed representative perimeter-column shell segment inherited from I01/I02A section dimensions, fixed only at its upper and lower ends. The 0.35 ms window ends near the first axial bar-wave support round trip estimated from sqrt(E/rho); shell-wave support influence is not rigorously excluded. No spandrel, neighboring columns, floor, core, global tower compliance, prestress or exact impact-panel plate schedule.

wing_bay.classification: Small rectangular I02A-like bay with two skins, front/rear spars, two end ribs and one top Z-stringer. Dimensions are a bounded numerical specimen, not Boeing rib-station geometry. Shell midsurfaces intersect ideally; offsets through shell thickness are not resolved.

facade_steel.classification: Representative I01 LAW2 steel reference with failure disabled; not the exact struck WTC1 plate.

skin_2024_t3_reference.classification: I02A elastic-perfectly-plastic 2024-T3 clad-sheet reference; no failure, no rate dependence, not Boeing production allowables.

internal_7075_t6_reference.classification: I02A elastic-perfectly-plastic internal reference; no failure, no rate dependence, approximate assignment.

connection.law: LAW117 with TYPE43, Imass=1, Idel=4, Irupt=2, EXP_B=2, EXP_BK=1, Gamma=1, full geometric nonlinearities

unbreakable_reference.classification: Finite compliant no-failure-over-window upper reference. It preserves the rupturable law initial stiffness but deliberately moves damage initiation far outside the short contact window.

connection.classification: The I02D traction, stiffness and energy proxy is spread by physical cohesive cell area over the full 203.2 x 25.4 mm attachment band. The area equals 20.32 I02D reference areas; this is a smeared equivalent, not a rivet count or calibrated Boeing joint. R0-R4 did not isolate the cost because output was not printed each cycle. R5 measured a constant 3.3674e-9 ms step caused by the former 1e-12 g/mm2 numerical areal mass. R6 uses 1e-4 g/mm2, totaling 0.516128 g or about 0.026 percent of the shell bay mass, and balances the same declared mass into the tied reference. A 1e-5 g/mm2 impact sensitivity is required. R6 retains the explicit half-thickness sum, (2.54 + 3.175)/2 = 2.8575 mm. Strength, initial separation stiffness and fracture energy are unchanged.

contact.type: TYPE7 one-way all wing-bay shell nodes to the closed facade-column shell
contact.classification: Short first-contact diagnostic. Post-folding, self-intersection and edge-dominated states remain outside qualification.
